Per share NAV at end of period: 2025 $8.94
Ratios to average net asset value: Net investment income 2025 8.52%

findings.detail: The extracted distribution_rate is 19.2119%, but source dividends of $0.82 per share over ending NAV of $8.94 support about 9.17%, which does not exceed 1.5 times the 8.52% NII yield.

rationale: F16 is an aggregate fund-financials check. The filing source reports 2025 dividends to common shareholders of $0.82 per share, ending NAV of $8.94, and net investment income of 8.52% of average net asset value. Those source figures imply a distribution rate of about 9.17% using ending NAV, below the F16 threshold of 12.78% (8.52% * 1.5). The flagged observed value of 19.211946% is therefore not source-supported and localizes to the derived distribution_rate field.
